package.name: robotar_mission
package.description: Scripted mission layer for the Robotar olive-harvesting vertical slice. odom_driver performs the closed-loop row drive using drive_controller odometry; harvest_demo runs the WAIT_FOR_CONTROLLERS -> STOW -> DRIVE_TO_TREE -> STOP -> PRE_POSITION -> INSERT -> COMB -> DETACH -> RETRACT -> DONE state machine with base-stationary comb interlock, comb/branch contact gating and detachable-olive acknowledgement handling. Scenario geometry comes from robotar_gazebo/config/orchard.yaml and robot geometry from robotar_description/config/physical.yaml; this package adds only mission timing, tolerances, arm poses and comb parameters (harvest_demo.yaml).
